book.name: Jems
book.title: Jems Jems köp kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Nɨbi bɨ nan iru mɨdöp gau
Kale nɨbi bɨ gep yabɨƚ gau, manö hagnɨg gabin i nɨŋim! Marö kub udnɨg gabim rö, mög gö mɨɫöŋ göl gɨ mɨdaimim.
Uɫpö kɨƚno kɨbap mani nan aij kale iru mɨdmɨdöp gau hadö papɨƚ gɨ hij gɨ lugöp. Waƚɨj aij iru nöp kale mɨdmɨdöp gau, gɨse pro ñɨŋ ñɨŋ mɨgan mɨgan juöp.

Gol silpa kale hij gɨ lugöp rö, kale nan si nan naij gɨpim u nɨŋ aij gɨnabim. Hañ romaŋ kale abe mab mɨɫaŋ rö inöm hij gɨ lugnab. Ñɨn hain u söl auab magö i, kale uɫpö kɨƚno kɨbap mani nan gau iru nöp ud gau pi gɨpim.
Nɨŋim! Nɨbi bɨ wög naböŋ kale gɨpal gau, kalɨp pe ñagpe, kale uɫham mɨdöm mɨɫöŋ gɨlö, Bɨ Kub kƚö ke yabɨƚ u nɨŋöb.
Kale mɨnöŋ naböŋ adö iƚ i mɨdmim, wög waryö gagim yɨharɨŋ mɨdmim, mɨñ mɨñ yabɨƚ gɨ ajpim. Anɨb u, kaj gau muk aij göm, mol gö pak ñɨŋbal rö mɨdpim u, magö mɨlö mɨdageinabim.
Nɨbi bɨ aij kalöp nan naij ap gagpal gau, kalɨp piral hagmim al pak lɨbim.
Marö auainɨm, iru maru jɨ nɨŋagun, Bɨ Kub auab a gun nɨp abad mɨdaiun

Anɨb u, añ mam bɨ. Marö auainɨm, iru maru jɨ nɨŋagun; Bɨ Kub auab, a gun, nɨp abad mɨdaiun. Nɨbi bɨ nan wög gɨ yɨmöm abad mɨdlö nɨŋöl gɨ, möŋ lugö, yɨŋ apranöm, magö aij pɨlnab. Kale u rö nöp Bɨ Kub nɨp abad mɨdaimim.
Bɨ Kub aunab ñɨn u yöp söl mɨdöp, a gɨmim, gasɨ halö abad mɨdaimim.
Pen añ mam bɨ. Añ mam rɨmnap kalɨp hag juagmim. Kale añ mam hag jueinabim u, Bɨ Kub kalöp pen manö kub hagnab. Bɨ manö kub hagnab u söl au mɨdöp; uƚep magö u nöp aunab.

Añ mam bɨ. Bɨ God manö hagep hadame nöp mɨdmɨdal gau, Bɨ Kub manö nɨpe haglö, kalɨp gɨ naij gɨlö nɨŋöl gɨ, bɨsƚam yabɨƚ mɨdmɨdal u pen kale iru maru jɨ nɨŋagla. Kale agamɨj mɨd aij gɨla. Kale u rö nöp adö anɨbu nöp gɨmim.

Kale nɨŋbim, nɨbi bɨ gɨ aij göm, iru maru gö jɨ nɨŋagla gau, kale uri mɨñ mɨñ göl gɨ mɨd aij gɨpal, a gɨpun. Bɨ ne Job hadame nöp mɨdmɨdöp, aiud u nɨŋbim. Nɨp marö kub auö, bɨsƚam mɨdeia ñɨn u, Bɨ Kub nɨp gasɨ nɨŋöl gɨ mɨdöm, mɨd dap arö nɨŋöl gɨ, Bɨ Kub Job nɨp gɨ aij gö, hainö mɨd aij ga. Nɨhön gɨnɨg: Bɨ Kub nɨpe pör pör nɨbi bɨ mög yabɨƚ nɨŋöm, ud aij yabɨƚ göp.

Pen añ mam bɨ. Nan kub yabɨƚ u, God hib nɨpe u yɨharɨŋ hagagmim. “God nɨŋ mɨdöp rö, nɨŋö hagabun,” a gɨmim, hagagmim. “Kumi kabö adö laŋ mɨdöp rö, nɨŋö hagabun,” a gɨmim, hagagmim. “Mɨnöŋ iƚ i mɨdöp rö, nɨŋö hagabun,” a gɨmim, hagagmim. “Nan gau nan rɨmnap mɨdöp rö, nɨŋö hagabun,” a gɨmim, hagagmim. Yau, a gɨnabim u, “Yau” nöp, a gɨmim. Wasö, gɨnabim u, “Wasö” nöp gɨmim. Wasö u, manö kub udnabim.
Sabe gɨmim
Kalöp nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap marö gainɨm, kale Bɨ Kub nɨp sabe gɨmim. Kale nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap mɨñ mɨñ gɨnabim u, kɨmap rɨmnap hagmim, Bɨ Kub hib nɨpe hagpe adö araŋ.
Kalöp nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap nan gainɨm, Krais nɨbi bɨ nɨpe gau abad mɨdpal bɨ kub gau hagpe apöm, sabe göm, Bɨ Kub hib hagöm, wel rɨmnap lɨ ñöl.
Pen Bɨ Kub nɨp nɨŋ udöm sabe gɨnaböl u, Bɨ Kub nɨpe gö, nan gɨnab anɨbu kamɨŋ lɨnab; nan si nan naij gɨpal u, Bɨ Kub nɨpe nɨŋöm arö gɨnab.

Anɨb u, nan si nan naij gɨpim u, pen pen hag hiɨkmim, ne ke abe, añ mam gau abe, Bɨ Kub nɨp sabe gɨpe, nɨpe gö kalöp kamɨŋ lɨnɨm. Nɨbi bɨ Bɨ Kub hagöp rö gɨpal gau, nɨp sabe gɨlö, Bɨ Kub nɨpe kƚö nɨpe göm, ke yabɨƚ gɨnab.
Bɨ God manö hagep Ilaija, bɨ yɨharɨŋ hon rö u pen möŋ alagnɨm, a göm, God nɨp kƚö göm hag nɨŋö, mɨ mɨhau nɨgaŋ rakɨn unbö kagoƚ jɨŋ möŋ alaga.
Hainö pen nɨpe kauyaŋ God nɨp hag nɨŋö, kumi kabö adö laŋ nɨbö möŋ lugö, mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i nan wög gau apranöm, nan magö pɨla.

Añ mam bɨ. Nɨbi bɨ kale rɨmnap Krais manö nɨŋö u arö gɨlö, kalɨp hag ñɨ aij gɨpe, kauyaŋ Krais nɨp nɨŋ udnaböl u aij. Anɨg gɨmim me, nan si nan naij nɨhön nɨhön gɨpal gau, God nɨŋöm arö gö, hainö umöm böŋ nöp umagnaböl.
